# The variant classifier

<!-- Generated by `./gradlew :codex:lore --args=variants`. Do not edit; VariantReportTest fails when this
     page and a fresh run disagree. -->

Story 7.8 ([ADR-0022](../adr/0022-variant-classifier.md)). `VariantClassifier` reads
`codex/v4.0.2/vocabulary.json` and the text of a claim and says `spd`, `pd`,
`mod:<name>` or `unknown`, with the evidence. It never guesses: no evidence, or evidence that points
both ways, is `unknown`. Nothing below changed a claim file; a disagreement is listed and a variant a
person set stays.

## The labelled fixture

48 claims whose variant is fixed by the source (`shatterfish/codex/src/test/resources/variant-fixture.txt`). The thresholds were
written in the story file before the first run: precision at least 0.95 and recall at least 0.9 for every class.

| Class | In fixture | Called | Right | Precision | Recall |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| spd | 18 | 18 | 18 | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| pd | 15 | 15 | 15 | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| mod | 5 | 5 | 5 | 1.00 | 1.00 |
| unknown | 10 | 10 | 10 | 1.00 | 1.00 |

What the fixture cannot show: its cases either carry a signal or were written to carry none, so it
guards the rules against regression and says nothing about forum text in the wild.

## The 146 claims under `lore/`

The classifier decides 38 of 146 and leaves 108 `unknown`. Result: spd 38, unknown 108. Variants the claims carry (set by a person): pd 1, spd 66, unknown 79.

| Carried -> classified | Claims |
|---|---:|
| pd -> unknown | 1 |
| spd -> spd | 21 |
| spd -> unknown | 45 |
| unknown -> spd | 17 |
| unknown -> unknown | 62 |

None.

### Carried a variant, classifier says unknown

46 claims carry `spd` or `pd` that the classifier cannot confirm from the text, the subjects
and the source type: a shared name with no differing figure, or a variant the person took from the page the
source URL names, which is not an input. They are not disagreements; the carried variant stands.
